dispositions.note: Confirmed against the artifact: paragraph 4 really does leave rollout versus wait-for-a-second-cohort open, with no sentence choosing between them. This needs to be settled before the note goes to anyone deciding on a wider rollout.

The 0.60 hedge ratio is real, but nearly all of it tracks limitations the note itself names: a small sample, a fall cohort skewed toward experienced hires, and a manager-availability confound. Stripping those hedges to pass the ratio would overstate what one pilot cohort actually supports. Leaving the wording as-is on this point.
Cheap, low-risk fix. Adding an explicit marker phrase where the note lands on its recommendation costs nothing and helps a reader who is skimming rather than reading straight through.
